enhancement.response:
Your GitHub Graveyard app is ready to haul your forgotten code out of the shadows.

- Click "Find My Ghosts 👻" to fetch real open issues and pull requests across your profile using the GitHub MCP (`github__get_me` and `github__search_issues`).
- Use the "Scan Repo" input to target a specific `owner/repo` and isolate stale work in individual projects.
- Browse categorized ghosts sorted into Forgotten, Waiting, Abandoned, and Needs Attention based on actual inactivity timestamps.
- Check your Ghost Score metric to quickly gauge how haunted your profile or repository is by unmaintained work.
- Review clear descriptions derived from real GitHub metadata alongside working direct links to inspect each item.

To begin, tap "Find My Ghosts 👻" or enter a repository name like `owner/repo` in the search bar.
